Edit the supplied blank mochi-octopus mantle into ONE animation-ready themed skin asset. This is a body sprite for a real desktop pet, NOT a finished character. Use case: identity-preserve / game asset.
STRICT GEOMETRY: retain the reference head's very broad rounded dome, softly rounded lower edge, straight-on symmetric front view, exact body scale and center. The naked body should still fill approximately x=7%..92%, y=11%..89% of the canvas. Preserve the canvas aspect ratio about 1.125:1 and transparent margin. Small head accessories must fit inside the canvas, may use the upper margin, and cannot make the base head smaller. Do not crop or zoom. No shadow outside the silhouette.
STRICT EMPTY FACE: NO EYES, NO MOUTH, NO CHEEKS, NO NOSE, NO EYEBROWS. NO ARMS, NO TENTACLES, NO LEGS. The central face region (x=25%..75%, y=40%..76%) MUST be plain body color with only soft shading; animated facial features will be drawn there in code. Keep the lower rim plain body color to blend into procedural arms.
STYLE: same soft 2.5D collectible mochi/plush-volume shading as reference, gentle top-left highlights, subtly darker lower sides, lovely premium finish, clean cutout edges. Match the theme color carefully. ONE single isolated head and its attached head accessory, on a REAL transparent background; no white rectangle, floor, text, multiple views, checkerboard, sparkle particles floating outside the body, or other items.
